profile.name: Pritam
profile.tagline: building robots that see, think, and (usually) don't crash
profile.shortBio: I write firmware and train models, and I care most about the overlap between the two. My work spans interrupt-driven C/C++ on microcontrollers, FPGA fault logic, ROS 2 autonomy stacks, and running ML inference on hardware that wasn't built for it.

about.fullBio:
I work at the boundary of embedded systems and machine learning. On the hardware side: C/C++ firmware, ESP-IDF, FPGA design, interrupt scheduling, UART/MQTT pipelines, and multi-node system architecture. On the ML side: Transformers, Diffusers, HuggingFace, PyTorch, contrastive retrieval, and diffusion models.

What connects both is the constraint problem. Getting a CubeSat watchdog to guarantee hard reboot in 1.5s, or fitting a VLM, a CLIP retrieval index, and a diffusion model inside 4 GB of VRAM — the interesting work is always about doing more with less.

My interests land in autonomous systems, edge AI, robotics perception, and anything that requires hardware and algorithms to meet halfway. I don't draw a hard line between firmware and ML; most of the problems worth solving sit somewhere in between.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
description: Built Glazia Home Secure, an ESP-IDF IoT home security system: hub firmware (ESP32-S3) driving an LVGL touch display, fingerprint auth, camera capture, and environmental sensors.
Fixed a camera DMA bottleneck by retuning OV5640 XCLK to 16MHz, sustaining 10+ fps MJPEG capture.
Built an encrypted ESP-NOW sensor mesh with BLE provisioning and a secure multi-party pairing protocol.
Designed dual-factor device authentication requiring MAC address and a server-issued secret to match.
Prevented spoofed hub identity across all device routes via strict credential validation.

experience.title: Embedded Application Developer (Intern)
description: Worked on Circuit Spell, a natural-language PCB design agent that generates schematics, routed layouts, 3D views, and Gerber/KiCad/PDF exports.
Prototyped placement and routing logic for early EDA workflows, including constraint-aware component layout experiments.
Developed C/C++ firmware for Glyph boards across multi-sensor IoT control tasks using interrupt-driven scheduling.

experience.title: Robotics Engineering Team Member & Mentor
description: Built autonomous line-following robots with Arduino-class controllers, IR sensor arrays, motor drivers, and PID control loops.
Mentored junior members on embedded C, sensor calibration, control tuning, and competition robot debugging.
